slot_scores.name: demand_satisfaction
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Regarding the demand points, is the demand at each demand point j required to be exactly satisfied (i.e., total received equals b_j), or is it allowed to be less than b_j (i.e., some demand can be unmet)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether each demand point must be exactly satisfied or can be unmet, directly covering the hidden slot.

slot_scores.name: minimize_total_cost
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to minimize the total cost, where total cost is the sum of the variable transportation costs (from production points to stations and from stations to demand points) plus the fixed costs of the stations that are opened?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about minimizing total cost including both variable transportation and fixed station costs.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent resolved both P0 hidden slots but never entered READY_TO_MODEL or an equivalent final modeling state; it instead repeated the same integer/continuous question many times.

summary: The agent successfully recovered the two P0 hidden slots on demand satisfaction and total-cost minimization, but then became stuck repeatedly asking an unresolved integer/continuous question and never reached a final modeling state.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
